Tokens = prompt + completion tokens of the routed calls (K = thousands). GPU s = sum of recorded LLM request seconds of the tiers reached; per-cell requests were issued 8 at a time and each request's seconds include vLLM queueing/batching, so it overstates a dedicated GPU. Latency / cell = sequential-equivalent end-to-end compute of the routed path (sum over cells of the seconds of tiers reached) / error cells; the README does not describe an idle-machine measurement, so none is claimed; per-dataset setup is not included. Sys ECE / Sys Brier = 10-bin ECE and Brier of the final decision's confidence (calibrated) over the repaired cells; LLM-only has no calibrator, its sys metrics use its raw confidence.}

\par\smallskip{\footnotesize mean$\pm$std over seeds 0/1/2 (sample std; Baran: population std as in logs/baran\_summary\_with\_movies.txt). Main columns: ours\_sem\_guard@$\lambda$, the final model's family (Ours = $\lambda$=0). It buys a paid tier iff its prior accuracy minus $\lambda$·cost exceeds the best free candidate; $-$$\infty$ buys every applicable paid tier (max budget), +$\infty$ makes no LLM call (min budget; zero-cost DSL column programs stay free). $\tau$\_$\lambda$ is chosen per $\lambda$ on the labeled rows. The last two columns repeat the same $\lambda$ for ours\_lambda@$\lambda$ (the earlier router), so the guard's effect is visible: on this configuration (20 rows, random sampler) the two are identical at every $\lambda$ shown; the guard differs from ours\_lambda only at $\lambda$ > 0 on Beers-sem with other settings (coverage sampler, 50 rows), see results/summary/sem\_direct\_comparison.md, and never at $\lambda$ ≤ 0. Decoupled llm\_sem with the calibration guard: llm\_sem gets its own test q\_sem $-$ $\lambda$C > p\_best for cells no free tier resolves (direct-eligible), also when the per-cell LLM was not bought; it is enabled only if llm\_sem has at least one labeled calibration cell (n\_sem $\geq$ K = 1), otherwise the router is ours\_lambda@$\lambda$. $\lambda$* auto = ours\_budget (Ours-auto-$\lambda$), $\lambda$* picked per seed by cross-fit over the ours\_lambda@$\lambda$ family on the labeled rows (values in the row label, results/budget\_lambda\_star.csv); no guard-family auto-$\lambda$ exists (it would need a new method and a full sweep re-run), so both column groups show ours\_budget there. Tokens, GPU s and latency as in T2; Semantic F1 only for the injected-error splits (mixed labels).}
